task.description: Implement DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 per the validated (PASS) design artefacts in artifacts_in. DDL-01: new src/platform/ddl_validate.zig with ValidatePlatformDDL composing ddl_namespace.checkNamespace plus new lock-class and non-concurrent-index checks, first-failure-in-statement-order aggregation (AC5). MIG-04: resumeFanout() added to existing src/platform/migration_fanout.zig, querying platform_migrations_resume_idx for pending/failed tenants only. MIG-05: change seedPendingRow's SQL to ON CONFLICT (migration_id, tenant_id) DO UPDATE ... WHERE status != 'done', plus an isAlreadyDone() pre-check so done tenants never get a transaction opened. MIG-06: three HTTP routes in new src/api/routes/platform_migrations.zig (POST run, GET status, POST resume) gated by Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN per the existing onboarding.zig/webhooks.zig convention, plus assertNoOutstandingMigrations boot-time gate in src/main.zig::runApiServer following startup_assertions.zig's exact shape (typed error, FATAL log line, std.process.exit(78)). Read both design docs in full before writing any code -- they specify exact function signatures, error taxonomies, and the 3 open-question interim resolutions CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already accepted (MIG-05 AC5 = process discipline only, no runtime code; MIG-06 AC2 = caller-supplied known_migration_ids parameter; MIG-06 role = Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN).
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 is implemented (MIG-05 AC5 satisfied by the accepted process-discipline reading, not runtime code)
No mocks/stubs/fakes; all DB access via real PostgreSQL through the Pool
Real unit + integration tests written and passing for all new code, with own addTest/build.zig wiring (verified real by deliberate-break test)
